name: System search index (Core Spotlight, AppSearch)
plain: Puts app content into system search.
meaning: Apps feed items to the OS index so people can find them outside the app. The index stays on device but can reveal what content the app holds.

android.api_surface: AppSearchSession, ContentProvider, Android 14 on device app search
android.note: AppSearch is on device full text search; surfacing in launcher search varies by OEM.

ios.revocation: Settings > Siri & Search > App > Show App in Search
ios.note: iOS 18 adds semantic indexing via App Intents entities.

limits.headline: Can add its own content to your phone's search, like items, chats or notes
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app adds items; you see them when you search the phone
can: Show app items in Spotlight and Siri Suggestions on iPhone
Add searchable items through AppSearch on Android 12 or newer
Use App Intents entities for smarter search on iPhone in iOS 18
cannot: Force results to show up in your launcher search; Android brands differ
See what you type in the search bar
Index things you have not opened or created in the app
limits.reach_label: Only the content the app adds
limits.differs: iPhone uses Core Spotlight. Android uses AppSearch, with launcher support that varies by brand.

story.what_it_is: Puts an app's content into the phone's search so you can find it without opening the app.

marketing.name: Core Spotlight
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps add their content to Spotlight so people can find it from system search.

marketing.name: AppSearch
marketing.pitch: Google offers AppSearch as on device full text search for app content.

story.for_you: You pull down on the home screen, type a name and see a note, a contact or an order inside an app. You may not realize the app gave the phone that list.
story.for_makers: Makers get another door to their app. The index stays on the device, but titles can show up in results, which can reveal private things.

use_cases.example: You search for a meeting note and jump into the notes app.
You search a friend's name and see recent chats.
You search for a past order and open it.
You find a saved recipe or article by title.
A bank app avoids showing account names in search.
You search a song and it opens the right playlist.
A game shows a quick link to your current quest.

risks: Reveals what is in an app
story.android_note: AppSearch is on device full text search. Launcher search varies by phone brand.
story.ios_note: iOS 18 adds semantic indexing using App Intents.

technical_bounds: No cross app reading; user can disable per app
